title: Wireless microphone — input circuit
description: Reverse engineering the two-wire microphone front end of a JieLi AC7006-family wireless mic. The speaker endpoint is the ON M45 AUX input.

schematics.title: Mic input — observed connections
schematics.description: Continuity results as measured with the battery disconnected. Unknown values and unidentified nodes are deliberately retained.

schematics.title: AC-coupling — simulation sandbox
schematics.description: A generic source → capacitor → resistor filter for practicing CircuitJS1 editing and simulation. Not a reconstruction of the AC7006 input circuit.
assumptions: 1 kHz sine source at 50 mV peak
No microphone bias circuit or JL SoC internal model
Does NOT implement the five observed board parts as a verified circuit
